thread:
jordan.sec: FYI we closed the live containment window for the suspicious token access. Need to capture post-incident actions and who owns what. Key asks: RBAC changes, KMS rotation timeline, audit log retention tweak, and tabletop follow-up.

marta-oncall: thanks. quick status: mitigation done, no active anomalous sessions. created INC-2029 in tracker and assigned provisional owners.

akshay: for RBAC: recommend removing legacy 'service-deploy' group write from the infra project and create a scoped role for deploy-runner. I can draft the policy diff.

tia-compliance: audit log retention — we should bump sensitive key logs to 1y and enable immutable mode for the KMS audit stream. Need legal signoff for retention change, I'll start the request.

sam-platform: KMS rotation — we'll need a rolling rewrap for all secrets; estimate 6 hours of low-risk ops with blue-green rewrap. Question: do we rotate the root key or create a new customer-managed key (CMK) and migrate?

devon-sre: +1 for new CMK and migration. Root key rotate causes too much churn in older infra. Also recommend a short runbook for rewrap rollback.

akshay: I'll sketch the RBAC patch and the terraform diff. plan: remove group binding, add deploy-runner role with minimal perms, and run a canary in one project. Will post PR by EOD.

oncall-bot: New ticket created: SEC-5234 "KMS migration plan & rewrap runbook" assigned to sam-platform.

marta-oncall: action items so far: SEC-5234 (KMS migration) -> sam-platform; SEC-5235 (RBAC policy change) -> akshay; SEC-5236 (Audit retention/legal request) -> tia. I'll add SEC-5237 (tabletop follow-up + comms) and tag @jordan.sec as owner.

jordan.sec: good. for the RCA doc we should include timeline, detection query, and the missed alerts that let this run for ~18m. devon can you paste the detection query we used?

devon-sre: detection query we used in Splunk:
```
index=prod_kms_logs event=access_attempt source_ip!=internal | stats count by user, key_id, action
| where action="Decrypt" AND count>5
```

akshay: heads up — RBAC change will need an emergency rollback play if anything hits CI. I'll add a deploy blocker that prevents APPLY until owners manually confirm.

tia-compliance: legal asked for a summary of data types affected by KMS rotation. sam, can you enumerate secrets that will be rewrapped? should be a short list.

sam-platform: yes — db creds, stripe keys, s3-enc keys, jwt-signing secret. I'll attach an inventory to SEC-5234.

marta-oncall: tabletop: propose Wed 10am next week, 60m. objectives: detection gaps, comms cadence, ops runbook drill. who needs to be present? SE, SRE, Platform, Legal.

jordan.sec: add Product PMs and Support for comms practice. Also let's commit to delivery timelines: RBAC change by Tue EOD, KMS migration plan draft by Thu, audit retention request to legal by Wed.

akshay: ack for RBAC Tue EOD. I'll include a canary checklist and the terraform plan.

sam-platform: I'll have a high-level migration plan by Thu and a firm timeline after inventory.

devon-sre: I can write the detection playbook update and include the Splunk query + recommended thresholds.

marta-oncall: I'll update the tickets with owners and timelines, and schedule the tabletop. tagging this channel when calendar and PRs are ready. :calendar: :white_check_mark:

jordan.sec: thanks everyone. after tabletop we'll convert action items into backlog epics and track quarterly to make sure nothing regresses.
